Python — Texture Alignment

Correspond alignment.py♪ And for ♪ NumPy Local calculation. The external input is deep/The cloud coordinates are linked to the texture camera coordinates:`P_texture = R @ P_depth + T`.

API Reference

align_texture_from_depth

Purpose: From depth reverses three-dimensional points, transform and project to texture maps, output alignment texture consistent with the depth grid.

Parameters

Name Type Description

depth

numpy.ndarray

Depth data in millimeters.

texture

numpy.ndarray

Texture image data.

mat_type

int

Value of mat_type.

depth_intrinsic

Sequence[float]

Value of depth_intrinsic.

texture_intrinsic

Sequence[float]

Value of texture_intrinsic.

texture_distortion

Sequence[float]

Value of texture_distortion.

rotation

Sequence[float]

Value of rotation.

translation

Sequence[float]

Value of translation.

Returns: ndarray(H,W,3); dtype Same as the texture.

align_texture_from_point_cloud

Purpose: Order. XYZ A cloud is projected directly to the texture, and the output corresponds to the cloud grid.

Parameters

Name Type Description

point_cloud

numpy.ndarray

Point-cloud option or point-cloud data.

texture

numpy.ndarray

Texture image data.

mat_type

int

Value of mat_type.

texture_intrinsic

Sequence[float]

Value of texture_intrinsic.

texture_distortion

Sequence[float]

Value of texture_distortion.

rotation

Sequence[float]

Value of rotation.

translation

Sequence[float]

Value of translation.

Returns: ndarray(H,W,3); dtype Same as the texture. mat_type=16 (CV_8UC3) Correspond uint8, mat_type=18 (CV_16UC3) Correspond uint16. Depth source textures are usually 16 bits, the original element must be used mat_type.

Example

raw_texture = epiceye.decode_image_from_epicraw(
    document,
    epiceye.EpicRaw3DataType.TextureBGR,
)
texture = np.frombuffer(raw_texture.data, dtype=np.uint16).reshape(
    raw_texture.height,
    raw_texture.width,
    3,
)

aligned = epiceye.align_texture_from_depth(
    depth,
    texture,
    raw_texture.mat_type,
    depth_intrinsic,
    texture_intrinsic,
    texture_distortion,
    rotation,
    translation,
)
